questions.question: Before a rise in GDP counts as real per capita growth, you must:
options: Strip out inflation and compare production growth with population growth
Convert the figure to dollars and round it up
Add government grants to the total

questions.question: On a Lorenz curve, deeper sag below the diagonal means:
options: Harsher inequality — cumulative income shares lag further behind population shares

questions.question: South Africa's Gini coefficient of around nought comma six five signals:
options: Inequality among the highest ever recorded anywhere
That the Gini cannot be measured here

questions.question: The evaluation attached to social grants is that they:
options: Relieve poverty today but lean on a narrow tax base that needs growth behind it

questions.question: The Human Development Index averages which three dimensions?
options: Life expectancy, education and income per person

questions.question: DUALISM in the developing-country portrait means:
options: A modern urban economy running beside subsistence livelihoods in one country

questions.question: South Africa's succession of development plans in order is:
Indigenous knowledge systems strengthen development because they:
options: Replace the need for any infrastructure
Cost little, fit local conditions exactly, and carry ownership that imported blueprints lack

questions.question: The two families of globalisation's causes are:
options: Technology that made it possible and policy that made it permitted

questions.question: The 2008 crisis illustrates CONTAGION because:
options: South African banks caused the collapse
A collapse in foreign housing finance was cutting South African shifts within a year
It only affected the country of origin

questions.question: The terms-of-trade treadmill traps economies that:
options: Peg their currencies to the dollar
Export raw products whose prices sag against the manufactured imports they must buy

questions.question: Which counterforce to the divide is correctly paired with its example?
options: Debt relief — the global value chain
Building the South's own market — the African Continental Free Trade Area

questions.question: An externality causes overproduction because:
options: A real cost is priced at zero, so the product sells too cheap and too much is made

questions.question: Common resources are overused because each user:
options: Pays the full social cost personally
Pockets the whole gain of one more unit while the loss spreads across everyone
Is legally required to consume more
Owns a registered share of the resource

questions.question: Which pairing of tool and failure is correct?
options: Carbon tax — creates owners for the commons
Tradable permits — cap total pollution and let the cheapest reductions happen first

questions.question: Sustainability's three pillars are:

subtopics.title: The Pot and the Queue of One Hundred

questions.question: The 'two tricks' to catch before celebrating a bigger loaf are:
options: Price froth (inflation) and a fuller table (population growth)

questions.question: Passing sixty people in the queue while holding barely a tenth of the loaf shows:
options: A Lorenz curve sagging deep below the fair diagonal

questions.question: The 'blister' on the minimum wage hand is that it:
options: Helps only those who already have a job

subtopics.title: Taller or Better — and the One-World Shop

questions.question: 'Height is not health' captures the difference between:
options: Growth (more produced) and development (longer, better-schooled, freer lives)

questions.question: 'A glass skyline visible from a tin-roof settlement' is the drive-by symptom of:
options: Dualism — two economies in one country

questions.question: The repeated verdict on South Africa's development plans is:
The one-world shop's floor plan disadvantages the South because:
options: The North buys no raw materials
The profitable counters — roasting, branding, finishing — stand in the North while the South supplies raw stock for cents

subtopics.title: The Smoke, the River and the Seed Mealies

questions.question: The galvanising workshop's fumes over the school illustrate:
options: An externality — a real cost that appears on no invoice, so output is too high

questions.question: The river dies although every family reasons sensibly because:
options: Each extra bucket is fully private gain while the falling river is a shared loss

questions.question: Eating the seed mealies stands for:
options: Consuming the regenerating stock itself, cancelling future harvests

questions.question: The three-story summary of environmental policy is:
options: Tax the river, fence the smoke, sell the seed
Ignore the smoke, drain the river, plant the seed
Export the smoke, import the river, store the seed
Bill the smoke, guard the river, save the seed
